item.title: WABISABI
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Le:CODE
  • 発売日: 2019-12-20
  • スコア: 5.8/10 (179 人評価)
  • 日本語名: わびさび
  • 英語名: WABISABI

あらすじ

The summer blue sky over a verdant mountain village.

Across endless rice fields as far as the eye can see,

A refreshing breeze blows through.

“Welcome home!!”

Kousuke comes home from studying at an art college in the city,

and there to welcome him are adorable and kind goddesses who love him dearly.

Feelings and emotions come together,
